judge.description: Final arbiter — evaluates all rounds, scores, verdict

findings.message: Integer overflow in GetEpochLastBlockHeight: when epochNum+1 overflows uint64 (e.g., epochNum == 2^64-1), GetEpochHeight(epochNum+1) wraps to 0, causing GetEpochLastBlockHeight to return max uint64 (2^64-1) instead of correct value or error.
findings.suggestion: Add overflow check before incrementing epochNum: if epochNum == math.MaxUint64, return 0 or an error. Example: if epochNum == math.MaxUint64 { return 0 }

findings.message: Integer overflow in NumBlocksByEpoch: NumSubEpochs(p.GetEpochHeight(epochNum)) * p.NumDelegates() can overflow uint64 when epochNum is large, causing silent data corruption.
findings.suggestion: Add overflow check before multiplication: if p.NumDelegates() != 0 && numSubEpochs > math.MaxUint64/p.NumDelegates() { return 0 }

findings.message: Missing validation of method.RawName in BuildReadStateRequest: when method.RawName doesn't match any known methods, the function returns nil without error, potentially allowing malformed requests to bypass validation.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit error return for unknown methods: replace 'default: }' with 'default: return nil, errors.Errorf("unknown method %s", method.RawName)'

fixes.explanation: Added math import and fixed two integer overflow vulnerabilities: (1) in GetEpochLastBlockHeight, added check for epochNum == math.MaxUint64 and for nextEpochHeight == 0; (2) in NumBlocksByEpoch, added overflow check before multiplication.

findings.message: Integer overflow in GetEpochLastBlockHeight: when epochNum == math.MaxUint64, incrementing to epochNum+1 causes wraparound to 0, making GetEpochHeight(0) return 0, then nextEpochHeight-1 returns math.MaxUint64 incorrectly.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit overflow check before incrementing: if epochNum == math.MaxUint64 { return 0 }

findings.message: Integer overflow in NumBlocksByEpoch: multiplication numSubEpochs * numDelegates can overflow without detection when both values are large, causing silent data corruption.
findings.suggestion: Add overflow check: if numDelegates != 0 && numSubEpochs > math.MaxUint64/numDelegates { return 0 }

findings.message: BuildReadStateRequest returns (nil, nil) for unknown methods instead of returning an error, allowing malformed ABI calls to silently fail validation.
findings.suggestion: Remove the 'return nil, nil' after the switch and ensure default case returns an error: 'default: return nil, errors.Errorf("unknown method %s", method.RawName)'
